title: Drybite
summary: Drybite is a Blood Spiral spell used to deal very high damage to a targeted Seeker or Titan. When cast, the spell appears as a stream of purple energy. It's able to send Kipperin and Powerbonded Sabriel (further protected by her Truth Shield ability) back to their amulets, as well as immobilize Powerbonded Sorcerel for a moment, all in a single use of the spell.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
During the Foundation's assault on the Professor's castle, Drybite was used by Rassimov to send Kipperin, flying attached to Dante Vale, to its Amulet in a single hit. This forced Dante to land next to Rassimov.[The Divine Comedy]

By the entrance of the Fortress of Iron Will, during the war against the Blood Spiral, Tantras used Drybite to neutralize Powerbonded Sorcerel for a few moments following Sophie gaining the upper hand in the confrontation versus Kiel. Sorcerel was quickly able to recover and be of use again to Sophie.[The Spiral War]

Harrison Fears used the spell to send Sophie's Powerbonded Sabriel, protected by her Truth Shield ability, back to her amulet during the Vampire Hunter mission at the Castle of Vlad Dracul. [Lok's Leadership]

Wind once used Drybite on a Sabriel Titan. [PRO-027]
